description: This file defines a template class 'LockableContainerType' that extends a container with thread-safe read/write locking capabilities using a ReadWriteLock. It provides methods for locking, unlocking, and assignment operations with locking semantics.

classes.name: LockableContainerType
classes.description: A thread-safe container wrapper that adds read/write locking to a generic container type.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator with locking for copy assignment.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Acquires a read lock with optional wait time.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Acquires a write lock with optional wait time.
